NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 548 PM EST Thu Nov 19 2026
 

- Dry weather continues through Saturday with temperatures rising 
well above climatological normals.

- Next chance for rainfall arrives Sunday.

- Turning much colder Monday and continuing through most of next 
week with below normal temperatures.

&&

.AVIATION...

There will be an overall weakening of the southwest gradient flow 
during the night as high pressure over the Upper Ohio Valley expands 
back across the eastern Great Lakes. The hi res model suite indicate 
weak convergent flow off southern Lake Michigan leading to the 
development and eastward expansion of a fog layer during the 
overnight into Fri morning. The current indications within the 
guidance place the better prospects for fog from the KGRR area into 
the KLAN area, with lower chances for fog to reach KFNT or KPTK. 
Otherwise, the large scale high pressure system will maintain clear 
skies below 15k feet and light winds through the TAF period.

For DTW...The chances for any early morning fog are too low to carry 
in the TAF at this time.
